name: application-file-uploaders
title: File Uploaders
description: File input components supporting drag-and-drop zones and button-triggered file pickers for uploading documents, images, and data files.
useWhen: Users need to attach one or more files to a form submission, record, or workspace.
Building image upload flows for profile photos, document imports, or media libraries.
Offering a drag-and-drop surface as a primary or secondary upload path alongside a button.
avoidWhen: The file is generated or selected from an existing resource — use a file picker or select instead.
Upload size limits are very small — communicate constraints clearly and validate client-side before showing the uploader.
The platform is mobile-only and drag-and-drop is impractical — default to a button-only variant.
responsiveBehavior: Drop zones remain full-width and accessible at all viewport sizes. On touch devices, the drag affordance is supplementary and the button trigger is the primary path.
accessibility: Drop zone must include a visible button that opens the native file picker for keyboard and touch users.
Announce file selection status and upload progress via an aria-live region.
Error messages for rejected file types or size limits must be associated with the input programmatically.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Drag-and-drop upload zone with a dashed border, icon, and helper text indicating accepted file types.
accessibility: Drop zone includes a keyboard-accessible button fallback to open the native file picker.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Drag-and-drop upload zone adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark border and text colors must remain visible in both default and drag-over states.

variants.title: Base with button
variants.description: Upload area combining a drag-and-drop zone with a prominent browse button for users who prefer a direct file picker.
accessibility: Button provides a fully keyboard-accessible path to upload; the drag zone is a progressive enhancement.

variants.title: Base with button (Dark)
variants.description: Combined drag-and-drop zone with browse button adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Button and zone colors must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.
